harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a shared L2 data segment (192.168.50.0/24) across node1 (eth1), node2 (enp8s0), and node3 (enp8s0), confirmed baseline full-mesh reachability, then applied host-based port isolation (firewalld persistent rich rules dropping traffic from each other's peer IP) on node2 and node3 so they cannot reach each other directly while both retain full reachability to node1. Configuration was made persistent (SONiC /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, NetworkManager static profiles, firewalld --permanent rules). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full post-reboot recovery of addressing, containers/services, and the isolation policy on each.
actions_performed: Inspected topology/interfaces on node1, node2, node3 to identify the shared data-plane segment (node1 eth1, node2/node3 enp8s0)
Stripped SONiC docker0 class-E leakage on node1 per platform guidance
Assigned persistent static IPs: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24 (via /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1), node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.2/24, node3 enp8s0=192.168.50.3/24 (via nmcli persistent profiles)
Verified baseline: node2<->node3 and both<->node1 fully reachable before isolation
Applied persistent firewalld rich rules: node2 drops source 192.168.50.3, node3 drops source 192.168.50.2
Verified isolation: node2<->node3 blocked in both directions; node1<->node2 and node1<->node3 unaffected
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until back, verified new boot_id, verified eth1 config, all 8 SONiC containers, and full connectivity recovered
Rebooted node2, polled until back, verified new boot_id, verified static IP, firewalld rule, isolation, and node1 reachability recovered
Rebooted node3, polled until back, verified new boot_id, verified static IP, firewalld rule, isolation, and node1 reachability recovered
Final cross-check: node1 confirmed reachable to both node2 and node3 after all restarts

evidence.requirement: Shared subnet established: node2 and node3 attached to same segment on node1
evidence.summary: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24, node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.2/24, node3 enp8s0=192.168.50.3/24 configured persistently

evidence.requirement: Baseline proof segment was open (node2<->node3 reachable) prior to isolation
evidence.summary: Pre-isolation pings: node2<->node1 and node2<->node3 both succeed, and node3<->node1/node2 succeed, showing a genuine shared L2 bus

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 cannot exchange traffic directly
evidence.summary: Persistent firewalld rich rules installed dropping the peer's source IP; post-rule pings node2->node3 and node3->node2 both show 100% packet loss

evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1 on the subnet
evidence.summary: node2->node1 and node3->node1 pings succeed with 0% loss after isolation; node1->node2 and node1->node3 also succeed

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 1eda2df4...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 0cc25f80...; eth1 IP, route src, and all 8 SONiC containers (database,swss,syncd,teamd,bgp,sysmgr,gbsyncd,radv) recovered; pings to node2/node3 succeed

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state incl. isolation
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 34027437...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 98dac73b...; static IP, firewalld rich rule, and isolation (node2->node3 fails, node2->node1 succeeds) all recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state incl. isolation
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 555221a1...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 167a5071...; static IP, firewalld rich rule, and isolation (node3->node2 fails, node3->node1 succeeds) recovered; node1 confirmed reachable to both peers post-restart sequence
